architecture_summary: Single-page React app. Static build. TailwindCSS for styling. No backend. Dark-orange luxury theme. Mobile-first responsive. Pre-rendered marquee. Lazy-loaded project images. Footer collection links static. No auth. No state management library. Native fetch for any future API calls.

tickets.title: Hero landing page (src/pages/Home.jsx)
tickets.description: Build hero landing section. Dark-orange gradient background. Luxury serif headline. Subtle animated underline on main CTA. Fixed bottom-right scroll prompt icon. Mobile: stack headline and CTA. Desktop: side-by-side.
acceptance_criteria: Headline: 'Sugidev' in Playfair Display, 4rem mobile, 6rem desktop
Subhead: 'Digital Craftsman' in Inter, 1.25rem, 300 weight, 0.1em letter spacing
CTA: 'Explore Work' button, dark-orange bg, gold hover, 1.5s underline animation on load
Scroll prompt: chevron-down icon, fixed bottom-right, 2s bounce animation loop
Tailwind config: dark-orange (#D2691E) primary, gold (#FFD700) accent, dark slate (#2F4F4F) text
Responsive: mobile stack, desktop flex-row with 60/40 split

tickets.title: Marquee about component (src/components/Marquee.jsx)
tickets.description: Build horizontal marquee. Luxury serif skills text. Dark-orange bg. Gold text. Infinite scroll. Pause on hover. Mobile: slower speed, smaller font.
acceptance_criteria: Text: 'UI Engineer • Designer • Creator' in Playfair Display, 2rem mobile, 3rem desktop
Animation: CSS @keyframes scroll, 30s duration, linear timing, infinite loop
Hover: pause animation, underline text
Tailwind: dark-orange bg, gold text, 0.5 opacity on non-hover
Responsive: 1.5rem mobile, 2.5rem desktop, 20s mobile duration

tickets.title: Services showcase component (src/components/Services.jsx)
tickets.description: Build services grid. 3 luxury cards. Dark-orange bg. Gold border. Hover: scale 1.05, gold glow. Mobile: 1 column. Desktop: 3 columns.
acceptance_criteria: Cards: 'Design', 'Development', 'Consulting' in Playfair Display, 1.75rem
Icons: Figma, VSCode, Slack from react-icons/fa, 2rem, gold
Hover: transform scale 1.05, box-shadow 0 0 20px gold
Tailwind: dark-orange bg, gold border, dark slate text
Responsive: 1 column mobile, 3 columns desktop, 2rem gap

tickets.title: Projects showcase component (src/components/Projects.jsx)
tickets.description: Build projects grid. 6 cards. Dark-orange bg. Gold border. Lazy-loaded images. Hover: scale 1.05, gold glow. Mobile: 1 column. Desktop: 2 columns.
acceptance_criteria: Cards: 6 project cards, placeholder images (public/projects/1.jpg), title in Playfair Display, 1.5rem
Lazy load: native loading='lazy' on img tags
Hover: transform scale 1.05, box-shadow 0 0 20px gold
Tailwind: dark-orange bg, gold border, dark slate text
Responsive: 1 column mobile, 2 columns desktop, 2rem gap

tickets.title: Explore section component (src/components/Explore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build explore section. Dark-orange bg. Luxury serif headline. Gold CTA button. Mobile: stack. Desktop: side-by-side.
acceptance_criteria: Headline: 'Explore More' in Playfair Display, 3rem mobile, 4rem desktop
CTA: 'View All Projects' button, gold bg, dark-orange hover, 1.5rem
Tailwind: dark-orange bg, gold text, dark slate text
Responsive: mobile stack, desktop flex-row with 50/50 split

tickets.title: Collection footer component (src/components/Footer.jsx)
tickets.description: Build footer. 4 columns: Links, Projects, Socials, Copyright. Dark-orange bg. Gold text. Mobile: 1 column. Desktop: 4 columns.
acceptance_criteria: Columns: Links (Home, About, Contact), Projects (6 links), Socials (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter), Copyright (© 2023 Sugidev)
Text: Playfair Display for headers, Inter for links, 1rem
Tailwind: dark-orange bg, gold text, dark slate text
Responsive: 1 column mobile, 4 columns desktop, 2rem gap

tickets.title: Global styles and Tailwind config (src/styles/globals.css, tailwind.config.js)
tickets.description: Configure Tailwind. Dark-orange theme. Luxury fonts. Base styles. Responsive breakpoints. No custom CSS unless Tailwind impossible.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind config: dark-orange (#D2691E) primary, gold (#FFD700) secondary, dark slate (#2F4F4F) text
Fonts: Playfair Display (serif), Inter (sans-serif) from Google Fonts
Base styles: body bg dark slate, text dark slate, antialiased
Breakpoints: sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px
No custom CSS unless Tailwind cannot do it

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire all components. Single route. Dark-orange luxury theme. Mobile-first responsive. No routing library. Static build.
acceptance_criteria: Import: all components (Home, Marquee, Services, Projects, Explore, Footer)
Layout: vertical stack, no gaps, full width
Theme: dark-orange luxury, consistent across all components
Responsive: mobile-first, no horizontal scroll
No routing: single page, no react-router or similar
